transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Anthropic updates its policy to ban abusive use of its AI models, with new rules taking effect November 12. Confirmed by StoryBoard 18.
DeepSeek and Huawei are open-sourcing a full family of AI tools, challenging NVIDIA's CUDA dominance in the process. Still open, per 手机网易网.
Google launches a Gemini agent alongside TPU sales and Constellation power developments. Reported by TradingView.
Anthropic's dynamic workflows found 66 of 70 bugs in code, outperforming single-agent detection rates of 20 to 38.6 percent. Reported by XenoSpectrum: Claude Managed Agents adds dynamic workflows in public beta, letting Claude run up to 1,000 agents per job.
Sardinia hosts Juventus in a key Serie A clash, with both teams vying for European qualification and Maldini leading the home attack. Still open, per 新浪网.
Free every hour.
